proposals.title: Make native JPEG timeline fixture pause intent explicit and failures diagnosable

ballots.rationale: At the pinned source, jpegEventViewer admits a same-session decoded frame without requiring playing intent, then calls togglePause unconditionally before waiting for paused=true (browser-timeline-events.js:647-659). The unchanged JPEG action inverts controller.paused (replay.js:543-559). The saved controlled production-established paused entry therefore demonstrates a real fixture-contract defect: the helper resumes valid ready pixels and its original 10000ms paused wait fails. P46's exact two-file test-quality scope establishes complete current owner/readiness, prepares pause idempotently with at most one production toggle, records bounded before/after/failure state and cleans helper resources on setup failure while preserving the original exception. This is justified independently of the historical CI cause, which remains UNPROVED. Approval requires the frozen playing/already-paused and held/unready/wrong-owner controls, original post-preparation predicate and all later pixels/clock/Stats/seek/emit/session/node/request assertions, unchanged budgets, both-engine registered runs and independent exact-final review. No direct state assignment, repair/retry, desired-pixel polling, product change, timeout relaxation or solved-CI claim is approved.
